SR-B1.ko: 거인 갈비뼈 화로에 불이 크게 일어남
SR-B1.equip: a heavy bone-and-iron brazier is set down with a deep hollow thud, a roaring fire whooshes up inside it, and the flames surge hungrily with a rising crackle

B1-02.ko: 화약 자루 내던져 퍽 · 맨몸으로 맞고 휘청
B1-02.atk: hurls its oversized powder sack into the foe: a coarse canvas whoosh, a heavy dusty thump that bursts through, then a gritty hiss of spilling black powder
B1-02.def: no armour, it staggers under the blow: a soft cloth-and-flesh thud, creaking sack straps, loose powder grains pattering onto stone

B1-03.ko: 도화선 불꽃 쉬익 기어감 · 몸을 사려 불티만 튐
B1-03.atk: a living fuse snakes forward: a dry rope slither over stone, a quickening sputter of sparks racing along its length, then a sharp crackling pop as the flame bites
B1-03.def: no body to strike, it coils away: a soft cord whip, a startled fizzing hiss, a few loose sparks pattering onto the ground

B1-05.ko: 불덩이 던지며 낄낄 · 몸이 흔들려 불티 흩어짐
B1-05.atk: a tiny flame imp cackles and flings a fistful of fire: a high giggling hiss, a short whoosh of a fireball, then a small crackling splash of flame
B1-05.def: its little flame body gutters under the blow: a soft flaring whump, a startled squeak, embers scattering and flickering back together

B1-08.ko: 연기 팔로 감싸 조름 · 흩어졌다 다시 모임
B1-08.atk: a billow of gunpowder smoke rolls over the foe: a long soft whoosh, a rasping airy hiss wrapping tight, a muffled choking cough from inside the haze
B1-08.def: the blow passes through smoke: a hollow airy puff, a swirling drift of hiss, the haze slowly curling back together with a soft sigh

B1-10.ko: 불 붙은 아가리로 콱 물어뜯음 · 으르렁 버티며 털이 지글
B1-10.atk: a fire hound lunges: scrabbling paws on cinders, a snarling growl, then a sizzling snap of burning jaws clamping down with a crackle of embers
B1-10.def: it braces with a deep growl: a thudding blow on a lean flank, smouldering fur sizzling, a short yelp and a shake that throws off sparks

B1-12.ko: 불쥐 떼가 우르르 덮쳐 갉음 · 흩어졌다가 다시 몰려듦
B1-12.atk: a swarm of fire rats pours over the foe: a rushing skitter of many claws, shrill chittering squeaks, the crackle of burning fur and tiny gnawing bites
B1-12.def: the swarm scatters from the blow: squeaks bursting in every direction, claws skittering over gravel, burning fur crackling as they regroup

B1-13.ko: 불씨 박쥐 떼 쏟아져 불이 붙음 · 날개 퍼덕이며 흩어짐
B1-13.atk: a cloud of ember bats swoops down: a rising leathery flutter, shrill squeaks, a pattering rain of falling sparks, then a soft whoomph as the fire catches
B1-13.def: the cloud breaks apart: frantic wing flaps, a few squealing chirps, sparks spiralling away and the flutter re-forming overhead

B1-14.ko: 달군 돌 던져 퍽 · 바위틈에 납작 숨어 끽끽
B1-14.atk: a fire monkey screeches from a rock ledge and hurls a red-hot stone: an arm whoosh, a sizzling whistle through the air, a hard crack of hot stone striking
B1-14.def: it ducks into a crevice: a quick chattering shriek, claws scrabbling on rusty rock, a glancing thud and a trickle of gravel

B1-16.ko: 도화선 불붙여 던지자 터짐 · 몸으로 버티며 펑
B1-16.atk: a match scratch and quick spitting fizz, a bundled stick of powder tossed with a whoosh, then a sharp booming blast that punches straight through
B1-16.def: no armour, a hasty crouch: a soft thud into charred cloth, a rattle of spare fuse spools, sparks sputtering out against the ground

B1-17.ko: 등딱지 분화구가 쾅 · 용암 등딱지 속에 움츠림
B1-17.atk: a lava tortoise braces its legs with a stony grind, a deep gurgle wells up in the vent on its shell, then a heavy volcanic boom spits a glowing lava bomb
B1-17.def: it pulls into its basalt shell: a dense rocky clunk, a muffled deep ring inside the dome, magma bubbling softly in the cracks

B1-18.ko: 불개미 떼 턱으로 집어뜯음 · 등껍질을 맞대고 버팀
B1-18.atk: a column of fire ants surges: a dry rapid clicking of chitin, a hot sizzle, then a crowd of mandibles snapping shut with a crunch and a tiny spark burst
B1-18.def: the ants lock carapaces into a wall: a hard glossy clack, a hum of clicking legs, a heated sizzle rising from the joints

B1-21.ko: 달군 엄니로 돌진해 들이받음 · 거친 가죽으로 받고 콧김
B1-21.atk: a fire boar charges downhill: thundering hooves on cinders, a snorting grunt, then a heavy goring crunch of red-hot tusks with a sizzle
B1-21.def: a thick scorched hide takes the hit: a deep meaty thud, an angry squealing grunt, bristles crackling and a hot snort of smoke

B1-22.ko: 세 머리가 함께 불 뿜음 · 갈기 세우고 세 목소리로 으르렁
B1-22.atk: three heads roar at once, lion, goat and serpent: a layered snarl-bleat-hiss, a deep inhale, then a gushing roaring jet of flame that splashes and keeps burning
B1-22.def: it rears and takes the blow on its hide: a heavy thump, a triple angry roar, the serpent tail hissing and lashing with a crackle of heat

B1-24.ko: 포탄 포신에 풍덩, 하늘로 휙 · 쾅 소리 받아 낮게 웅크림
B1-24.atk: a shell dropped down a tube with a metallic clunk, a hollow thoomp lobbing it skyward, a long falling whistle, ending in a distant crumping burst
B1-24.def: it ducks into its helmet-like iron pot: a dented tinny clang, a hollow ring, sand and loose pebbles trickling down the sides

B1-25.ko: 목 주머니 부풀려 용암 멀리 뱉음 · 두꺼운 피부가 출렁
B1-25.atk: a siege toad's throat sac swells with a long rising gurgle, a deep croak, then a heavy spit of lava arcs far away and splats with a sizzling hiss
B1-25.def: its warty bulk wobbles under the hit: a dull rubbery thump, a disgruntled croak, steam puffing from its skin

B1-26.ko: 용암 주먹 내리꽂음 · 바위 껍질이 갈라지며 버팀
B1-26.atk: a lava giant strides downhill with rumbling steps, swings a molten fist with a roaring whoosh, then a crushing impact with a splash of fire and cracking rock
B1-26.def: its rocky crust takes the blow: a deep stony crack, molten fire hissing out of the split, a low grinding rumble as it seals again

B1-27.ko: 불기둥 몸이 폭발하듯 덮침 · 불길이 흩어졌다 다시 타오름
B1-27.atk: an ifrit swells with a deep roaring inhale, then bursts forward in an explosive whump of flame, a crackling blast and a gust of scorching heat
B1-27.def: the blow tears through its fire body: a ragged flaring whoosh, a guttering crackle, then a rising roar as the flames gather again

B1-30.ko: 땅을 뚫고 솟아 물어삼킴 · 굳은 마디로 받으며 꿈틀
B1-30.atk: the ground rumbles, rock grinds apart, and a lava worm bursts up: a gushing roar of magma, then a deep wet gulp as its ring-toothed maw closes
B1-30.def: hard basalt rings take the blow: a dense stony clunk, a long grinding writhe, magma sloshing deep inside its segments

B1-31.ko: 불이빨로 물어 불을 옮김 · 비늘 끌며 똬리를 틂
B1-31.atk: a fire serpent rises from a lava stream: a sizzling hiss, a fast whipping strike, then a burning bite with a molten crackle that keeps smouldering
B1-31.def: it coils tight against the blow: coal scales scraping on stone, a hot rattling hiss, a puff of embers shaken loose

B1-32.ko: 끈적한 역청 팔로 덮어씌움 · 몸이 질척하게 삼킴
B1-32.atk: a tar horror lurches forward on heavy slurping steps, a thick bubbling glop, then a smothering sticky slap with a hiss of burning oil
B1-32.def: the blow sinks into its tar: a deep wet squelch, bubbles popping, a long sticky sucking sound as the weapon pulls free

B1-33.ko: 분화구가 터지듯 불덩이 뿜음 · 바위 몸이 꿈쩍 않음
B1-33.atk: a living crater rumbles deep inside, the ground shudders, then a thunderous eruption boom hurls glowing stones that whistle down and crash far away
B1-33.def: its basalt cone takes the hit: a deep dull stone knock, a low volcanic grumble, ash and pebbles trickling down its sides

B1-34.ko: 산 같은 몸으로 짓밟음 · 바위 가죽이 묵직하게 버팀
B1-34.atk: a behemoth rears and slams down: earthquake footsteps, a cavernous bellow, then a crushing ground-shaking stomp with rock slides and splashing lava
B1-34.def: its craggy hide shrugs off the blow: a deep rocky thud, a long rumbling groan, scree pattering off its ridged back

B1-36.ko: 왕관 도화선 불붙여 박치기 폭발 · 쇠 왕관이 울림
B1-36.atk: a fuse fizzing atop an iron crown, a heavy lunge, a head-butt crack and a huge booming detonation with a scatter of coins
B1-36.def: a stout iron crown and fat belly: a deep metallic bong ringing from the crown, jingling coins, and a big fleshy thump with a rolling reverb

B1-41.ko: 느릿하게 껍데기로 밀어붙임 · 재 껍데기에 맞으면 불길이 되튐
B1-41.atk: an ash snail slides forward with a slow wet slither and shoves its shell: a hollow crusty knock, a soft sizzling smear of molten slime
B1-41.def: it withdraws into its ash-crusted shell: a dull crusty clunk, then a hot flare of fire spitting back out of the cracks at the attacker

B1-42.ko: 끓는 몸으로 덮쳐 지짐 · 출렁 삼키고 불길이 되튐
B1-42.atk: a lava slime heaves itself forward: a thick bubbling gloop, a heavy molten splash, and a searing sizzle as it smothers the foe
B1-42.def: the blow sinks into molten rock: a deep sloshing splash, a gurgling bubble, then a burst of fire and steam spitting back at the attacker

B1-43.ko: 가마 문이 철컥 열리며 불길 · 벽돌 몸이 울리고 불길이 되튐
B1-43.atk: a walking kiln grinds forward on brick feet, its iron furnace door clanks open with a groaning hinge, then a roaring blast of furnace fire
B1-43.def: fire-brick and iron take the strike: a heavy dense thud, a long iron clang, then a roaring tongue of furnace fire bursting out of the door at the attacker

SP-B1.ko: 불 삼킨 거인이 숨결로 일제 사격 · 불덩이 몸이 흡수
SP-B1.atk: a huge roaring inhale, a pulsing rumble in a hollow chest, then a volley of fire bursts out with a series of booming blasts and spreading flame
SP-B1.def: a body of living fire absorbs the blow: a hissing flare, a deep rolling heat-roar, sparks swirling inward as the strike dissolves into embers

UN-B1.ko: 일제 사격 · 갑옷으로 받고 도화선 지글
UN-B1.atk: an old brass spyglass snapped shut, a gruff gunfire salvo, a rattling reload clatter, then the hiss of a slow fuse being lit
UN-B1.def: veteran plate and sabre block hard: a sturdy clang, a ringing parry, then a slow sizzling fuse crackling under the fallen heap

UN-B1-7.ko: 불씨 박힌 포탄 쏨 · 불씨가 번져 지직
UN-B1-7.atk: a glowing shell loaded with a dull pulse, a low thump of the shot, a streak whistle, then a spreading crackling of clinging embers
UN-B1-7.def: its thick smouldering coat swallows the blow: a deep thud, a soft shower of falling sparks, embers spitting hotly and spreading across its sleeves

EP-B1-1.ko: 수류탄 연달아 던짐 · 탄띠 두르고 쾅
EP-B1-1.atk: a rapid swish of arms, a rapid chain of bombs lobbed, then a staggered volley of fizzing pops, sharp booms and brass fragments skittering
EP-B1-1.def: a bandolier of grenades and iron breastplate: a deep clank, a jangle of metal pins, a dull rolling crash like a sack of bombs

EP-B1-2.ko: 하늘에서 불화살처럼 내리꽂힘 · 불꽃 날개가 재로 흩어졌다 되살아남
EP-B1-2.atk: a phoenix cries high and far, a long whooshing dive on flaming wings, then a piercing burning strike with a bright crackle of scattering embers
EP-B1-2.def: its feathers flare and burn away: a soft fiery whoosh, a crackle of falling ash, then a rising warm roar as the flames rekindle

EP-B1-3.ko: 깨어난 거포가 스스로 관통탄 · 주철 포신이 짐승처럼 울림
EP-B1-3.atk: an awakened cast-iron gun groans like a waking beast and lifts its own barrel with rattling chains, an earth-shattering boom, then a shriek of the shot ripping through everything
EP-B1-3.def: its colossal barrel rings when struck: a mighty deep gong, a low iron growl like slow breathing, chains tensing and creaking

PN-B1-C1.ko: 작은 불꼬리 휘둘러 화끈 · 몸을 말아 웅크림
PN-B1-C1.atk: a salamander hatchling skitters in with a tiny chirp, flicks its burning tail in a quick whip of flame, then a sharp little sizzle on contact
PN-B1-C1.def: it curls up tight: a small soft thump, a squeaky chirp, its wick-like tail sputtering and then flaring back up

PN-B1-C3.ko: 꽁무니로 끓는 즙 쏘아 퍽 · 단단한 등껍질에 탕
PN-B1-C3.atk: a bombardier beetle raises its abdomen with a chitin creak, a pressurised pop, then a boiling spray bursts with a scalding hiss and a splatter
PN-B1-C3.def: its scorched carapace takes the blow: a hard ringing clack, legs scrabbling for grip, a little warning hiss of steam

PN-B1-U1.ko: 화로 문틈으로 불길 확 · 무쇠 화로가 꿋꿋이 버팀
PN-B1-U1.atk: a brazier spirit's grate rattles, a bellows-like puff of breath, then a sudden roaring gout of coal fire bursting through the bars
PN-B1-U1.def: its riveted iron belly takes the hit: a heavy pot-iron clang, coals shifting and crackling, the steady roar never going out

PN-B1-U2.ko: 녹은 실 쏘아 칭칭 · 흑요석 다리로 받으며 지글
PN-B1-U2.atk: a fire spider clicks across stone on obsidian legs, a hissing jet of molten silk, then a crackling as the threads cool and harden around the foe
PN-B1-U2.def: hard obsidian legs take the blow: a glassy clink, a scuttling skitter, its magma abdomen bubbling with a low hiss

PN-B1-R.ko: 연기 속에서 내리꽂힘 · 연기 속으로 솟구쳐 피함
PN-B1-R.atk: a shrill hawk cry from the haze, a fast diving whoosh through thick smoke, then a single sharp burning talon strike and a flare of embers
PN-B1-R.def: it beats up into the smoke: a sudden flap of wings, a glancing swish, a fading cry as the haze closes behind it

PN-B1-E.ko: 심장 박동 맞춰 불길 연달아 · 박동이 흔들리지 않고 버팀
PN-B1-E.atk: a deep heartbeat thump from the shard, quickening, then a rapid pulse of roaring fire bursts, each one sharper, ending in a searing crack
PN-B1-E.def: the blow strikes molten crystal: a dense dull knock, a heavy heartbeat that does not falter, a crackling surge of heat

UP-B1-12.ko: 불쥐 떼가 화약 자루를 끌고 와 터뜨림 · 흩어졌다 다시 몰려듦
UP-B1-12.atk: a swarm of fire rats drags a sack forward with skittering claws and shrill chittering, a fuse hisses, then a sharp powder burst pops among the burning fur
UP-B1-12.def: the whole sapper swarm scatters under the hit: panicked chittering squeaks, heavy claws scrambling across stone, loose powder sacks thumping and embers crackling as they surge back together

UP-B1-17.ko: 거대한 거북 등 분화구에서 용암탄 쾅 · 현무암 등껍질이 받음
UP-B1-17.atk: a huge lava tortoise braces with a deep stony grind, magma gurgles up in the vent on its shell, then a massive volcanic boom spits a glowing lava bomb with a long rolling echo
UP-B1-17.def: it pulls into its vast basalt shell: a dense rocky clunk, a deep muffled ring inside the dome, magma bubbling heavily in the cracks

UP-B1-18.ko: 불개미 떼가 등딱지를 맞물려 벽으로 밀어붙임 · 맞을수록 단단
UP-B1-18.atk: a dense column of fire ants surges: a dry rapid clicking of chitin, a hot sizzle, then many mandibles snapping shut together with a crunch and a spark burst
UP-B1-18.def: the ants lock carapaces into a hard wall: a thick glossy clack that rings firmer with each knock, legs clicking, heat sizzling from the joints

UP-B1-24.ko: 정밀 박격탄 높이 · 철모 쓰고 침착
UP-B1-24.atk: a precise brass quadrant click, a smooth drop of a shell down a tube, a high long arcing whistle, then a distant pinpoint thunderclap
UP-B1-24.def: a tilted iron pot-helm: a light bright clang, a calm ring-out, sand slipping softly off its brim and settling in a hush

MB-01.cast: a squat cannon is rammed and fired: ramrod scrape, a deep coughing boom, then a spreading hail of iron balls rattling and ricocheting across stone

MB-04.ko: 도화선이 타 들어가 터지고 불이 붙음
MB-04.cast: a match scratches, a long sputtering fizz crawls along a cord, a short bang, then the target catches fire with a hungry crackling flame that keeps burning

MC-02.cast: a bayonet drawn across a whetstone: rhythmic rasping scrapes growing faster, then a bright steel ring and a rising shimmer of readiness

SB1-01.cast: a clay ball pops with a soft thud, a long billowing hiss of smoke spreading outward, a muffled rustle of cloth, a sinking dull hush

MB-05.ko: 불씨 자루를 던져 앞줄에 불씨가 내려앉음
MB-05.cast: a canvas sack swings with a coarse whoosh, a spray of glowing coals hisses through the air, then embers patter onto cloth and catch with small crackling whumps

SB1-03.cast: a low whoomp as a wall of flame rises in front of the line, a steady roaring curtain of fire, and a crackling hiss that settles into a protective burning hum

SB1-05.ko: 불을 붙이고 모든 화상을 한꺼번에 터뜨림
SB1-05.cast: a quick hissing fuse lights one target, a breathless pause, then a chain of flame bursts popping across many targets at once in a rolling fiery blast

SB1-06.cast: a stone shutter slides with a grating rumble, a hidden cannon barks with a deep boom, then a distant crunching strike falls and echoes

MC-16.cast: a mad scramble of powder poured by handfuls, a ragged thunderous mass of guns firing, with two heavier crashing slams over the roar

SB1-08.ko: 깔아 둔 화약통이 줄줄이 터져 양쪽을 휩씀
SB1-08.cast: a plunger slams down with a wooden clack, then a chain of powder kegs blows one after another in rapid roaring booms, a rolling shockwave, our own side grunting under the blast, and falling debris and cinders

SB1-09.cast: a whole line of cannons rammed in unison with a flurry of scrapes, then a titanic simultaneous boom, ground rumbling and a rolling echo

RB1-1.ko: 화약통을 빈자리마다 굴려 놓고 도화선에 불
RB1-1.cast: several heavy wooden kegs rolled over stone and set down with hollow thuds one after another, a striker scrapes, and short fuses catch with a row of sputtering hisses that keep fizzing, no explosion

NB1-1.cast: a heavy shell clunks home, a flat blast, a shrieking whistle, a crashing metal punch through a shield, then a long rolling thud

NB1-3.cast: a hot roaring gust sweeps in with a rising rush, flames spread wide across the field with a broad crackling flutter, then a whirling pillar of fire roars up at the front

HB1-1.cast: soft creeping footfalls, a lock picked with tiny clicks, a crate lid creaking open, a single fizz, then a muffled boom with scattering paper

US-B1-1.cast: a sharp cannon crack, a shattering hit, a beat of silence, then a second chain-reaction boom that rolls outward in a sequence of blasts

US-B1-2.cast: a glowing shell lobbed with a deep roar, a first blast, then a second echoing hollow blast with a rushing flame roar and sparks

PS-B1-1.cast: a gun hammer clicks, a stuttering spark fizz, then a muffled flash that bursts back with a sharp bang, a rattle of broken fittings

PS-B1-2.cast: a match scratched, a fuse lit with a rising hot hiss, a swelling crackle of fire rising stubbornly, and a deep resolved thump of boots

RS-B1-1.cast: an immense cannon thunder, a rolling spreading fire roar over the ground, crackling and popping, a heavier blast hitting the front

RS-B1-2.cast: a faint pebble shift, a soft step, a click of a pressure plate, then a ground-shaking bang with dirt and gravel rain

RS-B1-3.cast: a hollow shell burst releasing a hail of tiny glowing sparks, whistling streaks swirling and converging, one bigger concentrated hit

CS-B1.cast: a snapping of a spring trap sprung by flame, a torch tossed with a whoosh, a fizzing hiss, then a loud bang with splintering wood

IB1-1.equip: a battered musket is flipped and gripped by the barrel: the wooden stock knocks a belt buckle, a brass butt-plate clinks, one short test swing whooshes

IB1-2.ko: 탄띠를 두르고 심지 한 번 지짐
IB1-2.equip: a leather bandolier is slung and buckled: little powder tubes click together, a flint sparks, a short fuse fizzes briefly and is pinched out

IB1-3.equip: a flared-muzzle blunderbuss is hefted: a hand-cranked lock clicks, a scoop of shot rattles down the bell mouth, a wad is tamped with a thud

IB1-4.equip: a brass spyglass slides out in smooth telescoping clicks, a glass lens is wiped with a squeak, then a tiny focus ring turns and locks with a crisp tick

IB1-5.equip: a short portable cannon is hefted onto the shoulder with iron clanks, a glowing ember is dropped inside with a hot hiss and a rising crackle

IR-B1.equip: a polished musket is lifted, a carved stock notches under the thumb, a smooth lock cocks with a precise double click, a silent steady breath

PI-B1.equip: a glowing ember is lifted from an iron coffer with a low heartbeat thrum, a hot crackle and a rising roar as it nestles into the weapon

TK-U-BOMB.ko: 불붙은 통이 쾅 · 통이 둔하게 튕김
TK-U-BOMB.atk: a rolling wooden keg lurches forward with a hollow thump, its fuse sputtering faster, then a bursting detonation of splintering staves and fire
TK-U-BOMB.def: it bounces and wobbles when hit: a dull hollow wooden knock, staves creaking, the fuse spitting angrily but still burning
